context:
# Goal
Tabi round21 build/source/first-falsification wave. C1 only: depth, lowest non-retired tie8. Deliver 12 finite loopback non-autosubmit/auto-control scenario observations (not 12 novel branches, universal semantics or source diversity). Scalar remains8. Baseline e7cf11a810003d4a65cc85bd265f2c17dd65b738. Runtime is Chromium154.0.8037.97/Playwright1.64.0/Node24.21.0 with flags from r19, fresh private contexts, loopback-only server, no operator profile. Cases (fixed IDs): na-pending, na-click, na-requestsubmit, na-native-submit, na-reset, na-remove, na-reject, na-throw, na-delayed, na-invalid-submit, auto-positive, auto-invalid. Non-auto action occurs only after invoke and bounded pre-action observation. Observe, do not retrofit predictions. Pending means only no matching response within a named finite interval. Source S100 is reopened, exact tagged html_form_element.cc. Do not call script submission human-only.
Shared runtime output contract: scripts/webmcp-lifecycle-round21.mjs invoked --out DIRECTORY writes receipt.json with schema tabi-round21-runtime-v1, producer:{path,sha256}, environment:{node,chromium,playwright,flags}, cases:[{id,nonce,autosubmit,action,invocationId,invokeError,preAction:{windowMs,responseCount,formActive},after:{windowMs,responses,submits,navigations,pageState},evidence:{path,sha256}}], cleanup:{browserClosed:true,serverClosed:true}. Evidence is per-case JSON containing ordered CDP sent/received frames plus page observation (values dummy only), served fixture/hash and run nonce. Each case fresh context, cleanup even on error. Receipt shape can gain fields, never lose required fields; counter must not trust summaries without re-deriving correlated frames/digests. Report raw observed outcomes separately from source inferences. Unknown observed statuses retained; no fabricated expected status.
Counter files .ufo/waves/round-21/measure-c1.mjs and selftest-c1.mjs. Counter reads Git blobs at full 40hex commit; baseline missing receipt is metric0 exit0; complete evidenced fixed12 case-set gives c1_lifecycle_observations=12 exit0; contradictions/missing/drift give exit1 stable finding ids; input evaluation failures exit2. No browser execution in counter. Node builtins only. Export evaluate(files) pure and INPUT_PATHS for selftest, CLI --selftest invokes sibling selftest-c1.mjs. Counter runtime receipt default corpus/evidence/round-21/runtime/receipt.json; evidence paths under that prefix. Docs semantic review separate. All receipt observations are finite, no universal lifecycle certification.

# Scope and coordination
L1 owns canonical planner seat and integration. Every seat is leaf; no delegation. Read-only seats write only their uniquely named report. Production writers use only the clone path named in their item and commit there under tabi-shokunin <tabi@shokunin.local>; never write lane production files directly, lane jj state, lane Git index, fleet repo, siblings or source trees. All paths and every Report trailer are relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin — write Report at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/<that path>. Reports under absolute /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-21/w1/. No tests/builds/linters/formatters mid-flight; runtime executor alone is explicitly assigned the actual domain experiment, not general verification; final verification L1 after all returns. Message concrete interface findings to BuildRuntime/BuildCounter using actual returned roster IDs only. No actor-quiescence claims from task returns. Commit fixed writer blobs; integration imports those, not mutable worktrees. Do not revise prior lessons, especially round18/19/20. No external consequential actions, secrets/cookies/session values or REA devices.
Tooling authorized: read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first; install helpful official tools if needed, record tool/version/channel/reason. All pacman transactions PAUSED host-wide: use uv tool/npx/official binary; never pacman -S/-Sy/-Syu/-U/-R, downgrade or restart host services.

items.prompt:
/skill:godspeed
You are a Godspeed-enabled subagent.

1. **Name the axes.**
2. **Iterate cheap, in parallel.**
3. **Keep moves that improve any axis and harm none.**
4. **Don't aim — let the frontier walk itself.**

## IMMEDIATELY STOP ASKING CLARIFYING QUESTIONS. Execute tool calls concurrently in large batches. Do not serialize what can run in parallel. Do not output philosophical reasoning or verbose plans. Act directly via tool calls.

# Target
Only clone /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-21/clones/BuildRuntime. Write scripts/webmcp-lifecycle-round21.mjs and corpus/evidence/round-21/runtime/**; no other production paths.
# Change
Implement shared runtime contract. Reuse measured pipe/CDP/feature merging/loopback guards from existing scripts/webmcp-validation-round19.mjs; avoid copying unrelated validation gates. Locate Playwright through r19 resolver. Build finite fixtures for fixed12 IDs. Actions: no action; trusted click submit button; form.requestSubmit(); native form.submit(); form.reset(); form.remove(); respondWith rejected promise; submit handler throw (preventDefault); controlled delayed respondWith resolution; noauto required-field-invalid submit; autosubmit respondWith success; autosubmit native-invalid control. Retain observed errors including target/page disappearance without suppressing the case. Use explicit case-owned nonces and raw CDP invocation/response matching. Fixed bounded waits, accurately labelled as observation windows, not settle guarantees. Source reading S100 supports interpretation, not predictions. Execute the experiment once after implementation; retain argv/full streams/producer digest. No general verification.
# Acceptance
Complete12 observations or honest actionable blocker; browser/server closure proofs; no surviving run browser; isolated clone commit at fixed40hex with diff limited to assigned paths. Report commit/hash and exact paths. Do not touch lane production tree.
Lane root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin. Report only under its round21/w1 directory.
